issue_context.title: enable tiflash path for generated col in disaggregated tiflash mode
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
In disaggregated tiflash mode, `select count(generated_column) from t where xxx` cannot generate tiflash path.

Becase generated column doesn't support in mpp mode. And disaggregted tiflash only support mpp mode(cop and batchCop is deprecated). So it means we cannot generated tiflash plan where there is generated column.

To fix this, we can generate mpp plan by adding exchange_sender above table scan, such as: 
```
HashAgg (in tidb)
|
Selection(in tidb)
|
TableReader(in tidb)
|
ExchangeSender(in tiflash)
|
TableScan(in tiflash)
```

review_comments: maybe distinguish the `mpp` keyword is more effective
In non-disaggregated tiflash mod, may generate batchCop/cop plan instead of mpp plan.
Guess it's a bug. Will open issue later.
